messages.author: 7fc4e6d7d3655d9d
messages.subject: P values reported
parts:
Hello,
I am wondering if the P values P |z| reported in the lavaan output apply to the standardized coefficients reported as well when standardized = TRUE? Or does the value only apply to the Z test statistic specifically? Are these p values ever "corrected" through lavaan?

Thanks,
Jessica

messages.author: 12fdd832cacb825e
messages.subject: Re: P values reported
parts:
Jessica,

No, p-values differ between unstandardized and standardized
coefficients. Offhand, I don't think lavaan reports p-values for
standardized. But that's fine, because as a rule, base your hypothesis
tests on unstandardized, even if you also report standardized results.

Not sure what you mean by corrected.

Pat
